1.consolidated_definition: "Tajureo": insulto o expresión despectiva dirigida a alguien, generalmente con el fin de ofender o humillar.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Verbal insult or derogatory expression directed at someone, typically with the intention of offending or humiliating.
